empty.title: No inspections waiting for review
empty.body: No reviews in your scope are waiting for a decision.

unauthorized.title: You don’t have access to the review queue
unauthorized.body: This queue needs an allowed role — Admin, Planner, Supervisor, or assigned Inspector — with matching scope.

error.title: Review queue not available
error.body: We could not tell what state the reviews are in.

degraded.title: Some linked sources could not be read
degraded.body: The queue loaded, but one or more linked sources could not be read. Those details show as unavailable.

missingSla.title: Deadline settings missing
missingSla.body: No review deadline is configured. Rows show as unavailable instead of on time.

submissionBlocked.title: New submissions unavailable
submissionBlocked.body: New inspection submissions cannot be sent right now. Existing review records in your scope are still available.

readiness.noEvidenceBody: A linked source could not be read. It is not counted as ready.
